lyrics: I saw you at the bar
You said you were doing alright
Had a beer and a shot
And watched some drunk guys fight
Said everything's strange now
That you've been on you're own
Said time will heal it all
This is what I've been told
I played my favorite Morphine song
At the bar that night
Just for a few minutes
Everything felt right
We were drinking with a purpose and
Laughing at the pain
I called you Queen of the Dive Bars
Cause I didn't know your name
He had a rusted jukebox glow
Lit by whiskey and Marlboros
We bitched about Trump
He laughed at all my shitty jokes
He said, "Heavens just a place
Where they always serve dessert
And hell's a double feature
With a projector that won't work"
Now I guess I'll see you next time
Back around town
I'm here most nights
At least till things close down
And you just stood there in the light
Like a Southern Raphael
With a rose colored tint
And a look that said "kill"
